notes.title: Enter the Dragon
notes.content:
We're excited to be part of Enter the Dragon, an all-new event running from April 22 - 29 celebrating the fantastic games being developed by studios from across the Greater China region. 

[h2]Dev Broadcast[/h2]

Join us on April 24 at 12:00(EDT)/15:00(PDT) when we'll be streaming our game FISTS OF INVOKERS for 1 hour!

[h2]Discord Q&A [/h2]

Finally, there'll be some great community events over on the Enter the Dragon Discord server here: https://discord.gg/rthP9mcmGn, and we'll even be stopping by ourselves on April 24 at 13:10(EDT)/16:10(PDT) for a developer Q&A. Why not come and ask us some questions!

So mark your calendars and set your alarms - Enter the Dragon kicks off on April 22 at 19:00(EDT)/22:00(PDT)
